title: Focus on the Temple
author: Russell M. Nelson
calling_raw: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
notes_text: 1.  These new videos will be available in many languages on Gospel Library and other channels. Episodes will be published on a weekly basis beginning today after conference.

2.  As of October 1, 2022, four more temples are being renovated (St. George Utah, Manti Utah, Salt Lake, and Columbus Ohio), and three are awaiting dedication (Hamilton New Zealand, Quito Ecuador, and Belém Brazil).
